# S4.16b — C1/C2 retrieval and memory depth (§5c)

**Stacked on:** `svitali/harnessharness-s4.16a` (PR #80) · **Do not merge — operator-controlled**

## Summary

Lands the C1/C2 retrieval and memory depth (§5c): the
ranker family, out-of-process memory stores, the
consolidation cadence/guards, `adopt` incremental lowering
with catalog epochs, the hosted compaction lift,
`relower_summarize`/`fold_on_return`, the judged fidelity
declaration, the C2 lifecycle semantics, the
`subagent_task` target, and the boundary companion.

**Retrieval** gains `RankerDeclaration{variant_id,
deterministic, features_used, required_inputs,
model_conditioned_rules}` — data per variant over a closed
feature vocabulary. The kernel registers
`deterministic_default`, `structural_pagerank`, the new C1
`lexical_weighted` and `recency_importance` rankers, plus
the declared-but-unbound `similarity_rerank`
(`required_inputs` demands a pinned embedder —
`EmbedderUnpinned` until then). `report.deterministic`
reads the declaration, never a hard-coded variant table
(ADR-0310 D3, CC1).

**Out-of-process memory** is real: `MemoryStorePort` is the
23-operation contract surface the kernel's retrieval,
lifecycle and consolidation paths already read (`put`,
`bind`, `revoke`, `resolve`, `manifest`, `enumerate`,
`stale_candidates`, `reads_of`, `writes_by`, `record_read`,
`set_stamp`, `set_validator_verdict`, `mark_scope_ended`,
`publish_replacement`, `version`, `version_order`, `edges`,
`revocations`, `conflicts`, `applied_seq`, `drain_events`,
`take_lease`, `lease`). `memory_abi` is the canonical-JSON
dispatcher over that surface — strict codecs with typed
`CodecError`s, domain refusals as *data*
(`{ok:false, refusal:{code, detail}}`), and record outputs
wrapped as canonical JSON strings under `{result: "…"}` so
the V1 envelope screen cannot read a stored record's own
`label.authority = kernel` member as a forged plugin claim
(ADR-0310 D5). The same port is satisfied by the
in-process `MemoryStore`, the kernel-side `RemoteStore`
over `plugin_abi/1`, and the packaged `hh-memory-store`
plugin — one conformance battery runs all three (in-process,
remote loopback, spawned process; lease fencing, immutable
versions, resolve modes, revocation and lifecycle ports).

**Consolidation** lands the driver: cadences
`{session_start, idle, rate_limit}`, guard order
lease → cadence → guards → content-addressed
`{input_watermark, last_success_watermark}` diff; a closed
gate skips silently; dedupe rebinds names to the live
replacement; the conflict guard and `max_versions` refuse
before any write; `harness_overhead.consolidation` accounts
the overhead.

**Adoption** gains `adopt_with(AdoptInputs{loss_report?,
coverage})` — the incremental lifter's `LoweringLossReport`
plus a coverage oracle recomputing `permission_coverage` on
adopted entries; `adopt` keeps its C1 signature over the
empty context (CC8). Results rows fold
`action.tool.catalog.epoch` rows into the `lineage`
section's additive `catalog_epochs[]` +
`configuration_drift` members.

**Hosted compaction** lifts both spellings — Inspect
`CompactionEvent` and Claude-Code `compact_boundary` —
through `normalize_compaction` into
`context.compaction.{started,completed}`: `applied_ops`
verbatim when reported, else the format default stamped
`applied_ops_source = "format"`; `tokens_before/after`
lifted (nested `compact_metadata` included) or honestly
absent; component metrics `n/a{class}`; envelope stays
`origin = participant`/`authority = unverified` (CC2).

**Summarization** is executable: `Summarizer` is a
caller-supplied port — the only op that may call a model,
and only through the caller's gateway (I-BUDGET).
`execute` summarize emits `label`, `derived_from`,
`insert_at`, `summariser_usage`; a declared
`input_reduction` applies once on `SummarizerOverflow` and
is recorded `input_reduction_applied`, then success or the
deterministic fallback. `relower_summarize` and
`fold_on_return` are `CompactionTrigger` variants of the
same path; missing summarizer refuses
`UnresolvedSummarizer`, undeclared ops `UnsupportedOp`.

**Lifecycle C2**: `external_resource{validator_ref}`
dependency stamps, `justification_scope = subject_overlap`
narrowing stale propagation to shared `subject_key`,
`memory.stale_by_dependency_delivered`/`memory.stale_
acted_on` declarations, the scope-conditional empty-readers
deny, and `readers_required` enforcement.

**`subagent_task`** (AC-R-2.4.5-8): `select_target` rule
(iii) admits `SubagentTask` under `I(P)` ∧
`subagents_bound` ∧ `profile_declares_subagents`; the
override leg demands the same conjunction, everything else
refuses `DelegationUnavailable` (the AC-R-2.4.5-5 refusal
set unchanged). `lower_procedure` produces
`DelegateNode{spec, budget, permission}` whose `spec` is
the canonical `SubagentSpec` document — the schema stays
owned by `hh-subagent` (`spec_for_procedure` builds goal
`P` + bound params, grants over `allowed_capabilities`,
ceiling `delegate`, fresh context); `spawn` consumes the
plan node's spec (ADR-0310 D1–D2).

**Boundary companion** (AC-R-2.4.2-12):
`lab/compaction-boundary-v1` — `fork_by_reference` at each
`context.compaction.started` event ref, `fork_snapshot`
derivation, paired `applied`/`withheld` rows keyed by the
shared `forked_from`, fixed `eval_budget` `turns = 5`;
unequal arm budgets refuse `UnmatchedBudget` *before* any
fork (CC9).

**Judged fidelity**: `grounding.summary_fidelity_judged`
is the companion's declared optional metric —
`charged_to = instrument`, `headline = false`,
`detector = judged`, `oracle = judge`, native-only
`applies_to_classes` (hosted `n/a{class}`) — emitted
through `emit_judged`, the deterministic predicate over
caller-supplied judge verdicts (the judge critic itself is
§05f/S4.16c).

Requirement ids: `R-2.4.3`, `R-2.4.4`, `R-2.4.5¹`,
`R-2.4.2²` — closes `AC-R-2.4.2-{11,12}`, `AC-R-2.4.5-8`.

## Changes

- **`crates/hh-context`** — `memory_abi.rs` (new): the
  canonical ABI dispatcher, strict codecs, `RemoteStore`
  binding, shared conformance battery. `memory.rs`:
  `MemoryStorePort` trait over the 23-op surface.
  `consolidate.rs` (new): the consolidation driver.
  `retrieve.rs`: `RankerDeclaration` + `lexical_weighted` +
  `recency_importance` + closed feature vocabulary.
  `compact.rs`: `Summarizer` port, `execute` summarize path,
  `relower_summarize`/`fold_on_return`. `lifecycle.rs`:
  `validator_ref`, `subject_overlap`, `readers_required`,
  scoped empty-readers deny. `lib.rs` re-exports.
- **`crates/hh-memory-store`** (new crate) — the packaged
  plugin: `hh-plugin-fixture` runtime over the
  `hh-varhost` socket channel, class `memory_store`
  contract `1.0`, dispatch through `memory_abi::dispatch`;
  `plugins/hh-memory-store/plugin.manifest.json`.
- **`crates/hh-varhost`** — `RemoteStore` channel plumbing +
  `tests/memory_store_plugin.rs` (manifest decode, pin
  mismatch, spawned end-to-end battery).
- **`crates/hh-hir`** — `procedure.rs`: `select_target`
  Stage-4 admission (rules i/iii); `tests/procedure.rs`.
- **`crates/hh-subagent`** — `task.rs` (new):
  `spec_for_procedure` canonical `SubagentSpec`
  constructor; `tests/s4_16b.rs` (lowering + spawn).
- **`crates/hh-hosting`** — `compact.rs` (new):
  `normalize_compaction` + `CompactionSpelling`;
  `lib.rs`/`proj.rs` lift; `tests/hosting.rs` both
  spellings.
- **`crates/hh-compiler`** — `plan.rs`/`exposure.rs`/
  `schema.rs`: `adopt_with(AdoptInputs)`, incremental
  lowering loss report, `permission_coverage` recompute,
  `DelegateNode` product; `tests/exposure_c1.rs`/`s3_2.rs`.
- **`crates/hh-experiment`** — `boundary.rs` (new):
  `drive_compaction_boundary`; `tests/boundary.rs`.
- **`crates/hh-lab`** — `exemplars.rs`:
  `lab/compaction-boundary-v1` spec +
  `summary_fidelity_judged()`; `expand.rs`:
  `fork_snapshot` derivation arm; `tests/exemplars.rs`.
- **`crates/hh-results`** — `projection.rs`: `lineage`
  gains `catalog_epochs[]`/`configuration_drift` (additive);
  `tests/results.rs`.
- **`crates/hh-provenance`** — `origin.rs`: `forked_from`
  lineage.
- **`crates/hh-eval`** — `tests/s4_16b.rs` (new): the
  judged-fidelity emission legs.
